<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<package xmlns="http://schemas.microsoft.com/packaging/2013/05/nuspec.xsd">
  <metadata>
    <id>GameLattice.Core</id>
    <version>0.1.7</version>
    <authors>Toxic_Cookie</authors>
    <license type="expression">Apache-2.0</license>
    <licenseUrl>https://licenses.nuget.org/Apache-2.0</licenseUrl>
    <readme>README.md</readme>
    <projectUrl>https://github.com/Toxic-Cookie/game-lattice</projectUrl>
    <description>Engine-agnostic, JSON-driven RPG framework core: def registry with link pass, event bus, lifecycle boot, NCalc formulas with dice, deterministic PCG32 RNG, save/load.</description>
    <tags>game rpg framework ai goap htn behavior-tree narrative simulation unity godot</tags>
    <repository type="git" url="https://github.com/Toxic-Cookie/game-lattice" branch="refs/heads/main" commit="3cb66724216529aa782d1da5e4629f24e8feae8c" />
    <dependencies>
      <group targetFramework=".NETStandard2.1">
        <dependency id="NCalcSync" version="6.1.0" exclude="Build,Analyzers" />
        <dependency id="System.Text.Json" version="10.0.9" exclude="Build,Analyzers" />
      </group>
    </dependencies>
  </metadata>
</package>
